decisions.reason: The DPA management software costs little to maintain, fits the firm's expanding compliance direction and has drawn positive agency feedback, so the option stays open while its value becomes clearer.

The management platform is the flagship of the agency-focused strategy and has already received a committed follow-on investment rather than being a marginal option, and no evidence suggests its value is failing.

Extended PHP security support is newly launched, builds on existing know-how at low cost and serves agencies with legacy projects, so its uncertain value is worth waiting on, though it may later be folded into standard plans.
